c. 1776 BC: Shamshi-Adad I dies and the Kingdom of Upper Mesopotamia breaks up. "Shamshi-Adad's death c. 1776 BC led to the collapse of the kingdom"; his page: "Yasmah-Adad was soon expelled from Mari by Zimri-Lim" and "the rest of the kingdom was eventually lost during the reigns of Ishme-Dagan I and Mut-Ashkur" to "a coalition of Mari, Andarig, and Eshnunna".
